task.name: Coordinate_camp_service_visit
task.when: When the Dominatrix requests fresh-water, gray-water, porta-potty, or RV service

resources.resource: Service target and approved request method from the Dominatrix

step.action: Confirm the exact service type and target with the Dominatrix.
Request the approved service using the current on-playa method supplied by the Dominatrix.
Keep the service lane and route to the target clear.
Meet the service provider at the camp boundary.
Guide the provider to the confirmed target without blocking a service lane.

step.ifThen: IF the requested service is incomplete or a leak or spill is present, THEN keep people away, tell the Dominatrix, and record the issue in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log.

passWhen.criterion: The confirmed target received the requested service.
Completion or the unresolved problem is recorded.

reasoning.entry: One service-visit task covers the shared coordination flow without storing vendor contacts, payments, or private RV records.
